notes.title: Complete Graphical Overhaul for Silvern Moonrise 🌕
notes.content:
What's New?
The development for Silvern Moonrise is going strong! This latest batch of updates contains custom shaders, polished spritework, and continual upgrades to the player UI/UX to create a retro, CRT vibe. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610169/dbe2243e83498eb1241e12862b26d2204e5e85b7.png"]
New Enemies and Abilities
Added 4 new Demons, along with over 15 alternate versions of Demons all available for capture. Bring the best Servants that round out your party!

Added over 25 new abilities and sprites - each typing will feature a wide range of base abilities that can be further Enchanted into unique, powerful abilities


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610169/7780503657e2bd64e721c4f56f8a6249e69bd162.png"]New Ways to Enchant
Players can now see the numerical changes to abilities when Enchanting

Over 35 new Enchant effects have to added, including Faction specific effects like Devil's Luck, which allows your Demons and Hunters to specialize in high risk, high reward LUK-based combat
More Exciting News to Come, Wishlist Now!
The Demo for Silvern Moonrise is actively being developed and version 1.0 is ready soon, with replayable levels, 2 Biomes to explore, and over 10 different capturable Demons.

The beta version has already been approved by Steam, so expect exciting news soon! 😉
